newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt interbank o/n, one week rates widen.
newsitem.headline: Egypt interbank o/n, one week rates widen.

text.p: The range of overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Wednesday to 7 and 7-1/2 percent from Tuesday's range of 7 and 7-1/4 in a liquid private sector market, bankers said.
But one banker put rates much lower at 6 percent.
One-week rates also widened to 7 and 7-1/2 percent from 7-1/16 and 7-1/2 percent on Tuesday, they added.
Bankers said that public sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
